description: This file defines the 'Coocook::Schema::Result::Item' class, representing a database table for purchase list items in a cooking/recipe management application. It includes column definitions, relationships, and methods for manipulating item quantities and related ingredients.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Item
classes.description: Represents an item in a purchase list, including its properties, relationships, and methods for quantity adjustments and ingredient management.

methods.name: delta_to_value_offset
methods.description: Adjusts the item's value by a delta in its unit, possibly deleting the item if the new value is zero.

methods.name: set_value_offset
methods.description: Sets the item's value directly, adjusting the offset accordingly, and possibly deleting the item if the value is zero.

methods.name: _set_value_offset
methods.description: Internal method to update value and offset, maintaining consistency.

methods.name: change_value_offset_unit
methods.description: Changes the item's unit, updating value and offset, and merging with existing items if applicable.

methods.name: remove_ingredients
methods.description: Removes specified ingredients from the item, recalculating total value and possibly deleting the item.

methods.name: total
methods.description: Returns the total value of the item, including offset.

methods.name: update_from_ingredients
methods.description: Recalculates the item's value based on its ingredients, creating or deleting items as needed.
